title: CareSys
voice: Running a care agency? Or looking for your next caregiving opportunity? Meet CareSys. One platform, with a workspace built around what you need.

title:
For care
agencies
voice: Are you a care agency owner, looking for a better way to manage your business? CareSys brings recruitment and daily operations into one workspace.

title:
A clearer view
of your agency
voice: See what needs your attention, without jumping between separate systems. Give recruiters, schedulers, supervisors, and finance staff access to the work they're responsible for.

title:
Find your next
team member
voice: Looking for the right people? Search approved caregiver profiles by work area and skill, manage applications, and invite candidates. Keep your recruitment decisions organized.

title:
Plan the work
Support the team
voice: Plan client visits, review time and leave, and keep care notes and incidents in your agency workspace. Assignment checks help flag overlaps and qualification requirements.

title:
Keep business
records together
voice: Follow expenses, equipment custody, invoices, and receipts in the same platform. Export approved worked time for payroll preparation, with a clear record of reviews and decisions.

title:
For individual
caregivers
voice: Are you a caregiver looking for new opportunities? CareSys gives you a place to present your experience, explore available roles, and take charge of your next career step.

title:
Create a profile
that represents you
voice: Sign in and create your professional profile. Add your skills, qualifications, languages, and preferred work areas. When you're ready, approve your recruitment preview so authorized recruiters can discover you.

title:
Explore roles
Apply directly
voice: Browse published vacancies and their work locations. Find an opportunity that suits you, apply through CareSys, and follow your application status as the agency reviews it.

title:
Stay in control
of your choices
voice: Respond to invitations, review offers, and decide what career history you share. Your profile stays with you across agency relationships, and joining a new team requires your permission.

title:
Clear updates
Fewer unknowns
voice: Check your account for application progress and agency decisions. See updates as agencies respond. Response times depend on the employer, so an immediate reply isn't guaranteed.

title: Explore CareSys
voice: For agencies, a clearer way to coordinate the business. For caregivers, a place to be seen and pursue opportunities. Explore the CareSys demo and discuss a pilot.

title: The next chapter
voice: CareSys currently has a working local web application. Android and iPhone apps, regional subscriptions, and commercial hosting are planned as the platform prepares for launch.
